nodes.label: Isolated Test Schema (clavium_test)
nodes.rationale: Tests run in an isolated Postgres schema (TEST_DATABASE_URL with ?schema=clavium_test) mirroring the local setup, so unit tests cannot corrupt the database used by the build step.

nodes.label: Homepage 4-Slide Sales Deck
nodes.rationale: v1.1.0 restructured the homepage from a minimal feature list into a 4-slide, funnel-ordered sales deck, each slide targeting one audience (renters/buyers, owners, developers/commercial, how-it-works) with a single CTA.

nodes.label: SlideShell Background Slot (full-bleed fix)
nodes.rationale: .reveal.visible carries a CSS transform, which makes the content container the containing block for absolute positioning; the absolute inset-0 gradient was therefore clipped to the 1600px content width on wide monitors (visible only with animations active). Fix: render the background at <section> level via a new SlideShell 'background' slot, outside the .reveal transform container, leaving the content layout unchanged.

nodes.label: Server Actions Migration (v0.6.0)
nodes.rationale: Mutations moved from API routes to Server Actions as the idiomatic Next 16 / React 19 approach; client components call actions via useTransition, router.refresh replaced by revalidatePath, 12 mutation API routes removed. Auth/OTP endpoints stay as routes because they need cookies, redirects and rate limiting.

nodes.label: Sonner Toast Feedback
nodes.rationale: v0.5.0 replaced the grey status boxes with sonner toasts across all forms and actions; success and error are visually distinct and auto-dismiss.

nodes.label: QES Contract Signing
nodes.rationale: Each party signs via a pluggable QES provider (simulated in dev); when both signatures land the contract becomes ACTIVE, the property RENTED, and the first rent falls due.

nodes.label: KYC Identity Verification
nodes.rationale: Real face matching between a live ID-document capture and a selfie, with no auto-approval; phone-camera KYC works without HTTPS in dev.

nodes.label: BNR EUR/RON Exchange-Rate Feed
nodes.rationale: EUR/RON rate comes from the official BNR feed cached ~6h, with EUR_RON_RATE as a manual override and a fallback when the feed is unavailable.

nodes.label: S3/R2-Compatible Storage
nodes.rationale: Checksums forced to WHEN_REQUIRED because the AWS SDK v3 default corrupts uploads on Cloudflare R2; STORAGE_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE optional.

nodes.label: TOTP Two-Factor Authentication
nodes.rationale: RFC 6238 TOTP with backup codes, enforced on both password login and email-OTP login.

nodes.label: JWT_SECRET Production-Only Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Strict JWT_SECRET enforcement applies only to the real production deployment (VERCEL_ENV=production), so Vercel Preview deployments boot with a fallback dev secret without full configuration. Documented trade-off: preview sessions are signed with a known secret unless JWT_SECRET is also set on Preview.

nodes.label: Isolated Test Database Harness
nodes.rationale: Test harness with an isolated database (prisma/test.db) and mocks for Next APIs (getCurrentUser, next/cache, next/headers); integration test covers the full lifecycle property -> offer -> contract -> sign -> payment.

nodes.label: Dark Mode via CSS Token Redefinition
nodes.rationale: Implemented by redefining the CSS design tokens under html.dark; theme persists in localStorage, respects the system preference, and a no-flash script runs before paint.
nodes.norm_label: dark mode via css token redefinition

nodes.label: Server-Resolved Navbar Auth State
nodes.rationale: Login state is resolved on the server (getNavUser from the cookie) and passed to the Navbar as initialUser, removing the client-fetch auth flash; getCurrentUser is memoized per request with React cache() to avoid duplicate DB queries; the client fetch remains only as a fallback on client error pages.

nodes.label: Clavium Real-Estate Platform
nodes.rationale: Romanian real-estate platform for direct owner-tenant transactions without intermediaries: discovery, offers, QES-signed contracts and rent payments in one place.

nodes.label: Rental Lifecycle Flow
nodes.rationale: Property listed -> offer sent -> offer accepted -> contract drafted -> signed by both parties (QES) -> contract active -> rent payments tracked.

nodes.label: Four-Step Registration Wizard
nodes.rationale: Registration is refused server-side if the phone was not OTP-verified; public registration can only create CLIENT or OWNER accounts (ADMIN rejected server-side).

nodes.label: JWT HTTP-only Cookie Auth
nodes.rationale: JWT (jose, HS256, 2h) in an HTTP-only sameSite=lax cookie; dashboard access verifies both the JWT and the user in the database, so a forged cookie is rejected.

nodes.label: Route Protection via proxy.ts
nodes.rationale: Anonymous visitors to /dashboard/* are redirected to login and logged-in users are redirected away from /auth/*; implemented in src/proxy.ts (migrated from the middleware.ts convention, deprecated in Next 16).

nodes.label: Road to Paid Public Launch (tracker)
nodes.rationale: Phases 1-2 are mandatory for a real deploy, Phase 3 is compliance, Phase 4 is post-launch differentiation.

nodes.label: Design Re-Shaped: 4-Slide Homepage Plan
nodes.rationale: Sales principles per slide: benefit-led headline (not 'we do X'), name the pain (commission, scams, paperwork, time), handle the objection (QES + verified + encrypted), show proof (real listings + live counts), one unambiguous CTA.

nodes.label: AES 'Bank-Model' Signing Ceremony
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Advanced Electronic Signature ceremony reusing existing KYC + OTP (sole-control factor) + contractDocumentHash (tamper-evidence) + Signature audit trail, embedded in the PDF (PAdES). Removes the ~EUR 80/yr personal-cert barrier; legally sufficient for rentals and antecontracts. Hybrid plan: AES default, uploaded-cert QES for power users, on-demand QTSP QES later as premium. Needs legal posture confirmed first.

nodes.label: QES Provider Decision
nodes.rationale: Keep uploaded-cert verification (src/lib/qesVerify.ts) vs integrate a QTSP (certSIGN/Namirial/DocuSign EU Qualified) for on-demand QES.

nodes.label: Landlord Payouts (Stripe Connect / escrow)
nodes.rationale: Scaffolded (PAYOUTS_ENABLED gated on STRIPE_CONNECT_ENABLED, pure ownerNetFromRent, createOwnerPayout seam). Launch-critical and regulatory: the Connect / payment-facilitator decision and handling of third-party funds (payment-institution rules) must be resolved with legal before enabling real transfers.

nodes.label: Contract PDF Generation (pdf-lib)
nodes.rationale: On-demand, deterministic generation (unsigned preview + signed final) from ContractDocument, with a QES audit block (signer, provider, timestamp, ref + SHA-256 doc hash). Embeds Noto Sans for Romanian diacritics; outputFileTracingIncludes ships the fonts in the serverless bundle. Persisting a frozen signed artifact deferred: regeneration is deterministic, so functionally equivalent.

nodes.label: Persistent Object Storage (S3/R2) Seam
nodes.rationale: storageBackend.ts behind the storage.ts seam: local FS default, S3/R2 when STORAGE_DRIVER=s3 with the SDK lazy-loaded; env.ts warns when storage is not persistent. KYC docs remain write-only (only the content hash is consumed), so presigned short-TTL reads are still TODO.

nodes.label: Hash-Chained Immutable Audit Log
nodes.rationale: AuditLog rows chained via advisory-lock-serialized seq/prevHash for tamper evidence; wired into signing, activation, settlement, terms changes, termination/renewal/cancel/deposit; trail shown on the contract page.

nodes.label: Dunning (Late / Missed Payment Handling)
nodes.rationale: processDunning runs in the daily cron: upcoming-due reminders plus escalating overdue notices, idempotent via Payment.lastReminderAt. Penalty/late-fee auto-charge deferred because it needs a contractual clause basis.

nodes.label: Listing Fraud Detection (Perceptual Hashing)
nodes.rationale: aHash (8x8 grayscale -> 64-bit) with a Hamming-distance threshold flags stolen photos across owners (PhotoSignature recorded on upload), plus near-identical text listings; runs best-effort on photo upload, files a deduplicated system report and notifies admins. LSH/bucketing noted for scale.

nodes.label: Arvuna (AVANS) Forfeit Rules
nodes.rationale: cancelSaleContract: buyer backs out -> forfeits arvuna; seller backs out -> owes double per Civil Code art. 1544; admin/no-arvuna -> simple cancel.

nodes.label: Rental Deposit (Garantie) Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: returnRentalDeposit: held -> returned/partial/forfeited at contract end with damage deductions; records REFUND (tenant) + DAUNE (owner); idempotent via depositStatus.

nodes.label: Cookie-Based i18n (RO/EN)
nodes.rationale: Cookie-based locale instead of a [locale] route segment, with a typed dictionary system; ro/en key parity enforced at compile time (en: Dictionary) and by test.

nodes.label: Multi-Currency Display (RON/EUR)
nodes.rationale: Amounts stay stored in RON as the payment source of truth; EUR is a display representation derived from the BNR reference rate (cached ~6h) with EUR_RON_RATE override and static fallback.

nodes.label: Admin Support Tooling
nodes.rationale: Manual KYC override, listing moderation, idempotent payment refund, audit-chain verification - all audited. Impersonation deliberately implemented as a read-only support view rather than act-as, because acting as a user is a security footgun.

nodes.label: UX Review & Ideas
nodes.rationale: Diagnosis: the visuals are fine; the interaction layer (feedback, loading, consistency of micro-decisions) causes the rough feel - fixing the feedback model is ~70% of the perceived-quality win. Roadmap ordered by impact / effort.

nodes.label: Single Mutable Status-String Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Seven forms used one status state holding errors, loading text and success, rendered as a permanent grey box: success and error look identical, nothing auto-dismisses, and it reads like a debug log - identified as the biggest perceived-quality offender.

nodes.label: Toast System (sonner) Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Replace every setStatus success/error with toast.success/toast.error; keep inline text only for persistent states. Single change that makes the whole app feel modern; toasts also give aria-live announcements for free.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI (useOptimistic) Recommendation
nodes.rationale: 11 router.refresh calls across 8 components make every action wait for a full server round-trip; React 19 primitives (useOptimistic/useActionState/useFormStatus) were measured at 0 uses despite React 19 + Next 16.

nodes.label: Design Token System (radius/type/spacing)
nodes.rationale: 8 different border radii and 10+ ad-hoc pixel type sizes produce the 'unedged' feel; define 3-4 radii, a 6-step type scale and a spacing rhythm as Tailwind theme tokens, then sweep the codebase.

nodes.label: Styled Confirm Dialog Recommendation
nodes.rationale: window.confirm at account deactivation is jarring, unstyleable and breaks the visual language at a high-stakes moment; replace with a styled Dialog primitive reused for all destructive confirmations.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge-Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions go through graphify query/path/explain for a scoped subgraph (smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep); the wiki index is preferred for broad navigation; graphify update after code changes keeps the graph current (AST-only, no API cost).

nodes.label: QES Trust Anchors Directory
nodes.rationale: A signer certificate counts as qualified only if its chain closes into one of the root/intermediate anchors here (see src/lib/qesVerify.ts). Fail-closed by design: an empty directory means no signature is accepted (production refuses signing), preventing acceptance of unqualified certificates. Certificate files are operational configuration and never committed; path overridable via QES_TRUST_DIR.

nodes.label: Romanian Qualified Trust Service Providers
nodes.rationale: certSIGN, Transsped, DigiSign, Alfasign - qualified providers per eIDAS / official ANCOM list / EU Trusted List; their qualified roots and intermediates populate the trust-anchor directory.

nodes.label: Noto Sans (OFL 1.1) Vendored Fonts
nodes.rationale: Noto Sans Regular + Bold vendored under SIL Open Font License 1.1 for server-side contract PDF generation with correct Romanian diacritics.

nodes.label: RBAC System
nodes.rationale: Three user roles (ADMIN, OWNER, CLIENT) with named permissions; role stored as a string column on User with default CLIENT because SQLite enums are not supported by Prisma.

nodes.label: ADMIN Role
nodes.rationale: Full platform control: manage_all_properties, view_all_documents, manage_contracts, manage_users, view_all_contracts, view_all_earnings. Cannot be self-assigned at public registration.

nodes.label: OWNER Role
nodes.rationale: Property owners: view_own_properties, view_own_contracts, view_own_earnings, manage_own_properties.

nodes.label: CLIENT Role
nodes.rationale: Tenants: view_active_contract, view_rent_amount, create_tickets. Default role for new registrations.
